title: Hangar catalog model file
description: One file per known manufacturer/model combination. Imported into the catalog_* tables at startup and by `hangar import-catalog`. The Rust importer (src/catalog.rs) enforces exactly these rules with file+field error messages; this schema documents the same format for editors and external tooling.

manufacturer.description: Display name of the manufacturer (e.g. "OMP Hobby"). Matching on re-import is exact after trimming, so keep the casing stable.

category.description: Must match the category of any user model linked to this catalog model.

diagram_asset.description: Optional per-model diagram override: a plain file name in frontend/src/lib/diagrams/ (e.g. "heli-generic.svg"). No '/' or '..'. Omitted/null = the generic per-category SVG (<category>-generic.svg).

part_number.description: Official manufacturer part number. Nullable: adding a row can come before the number is verified. Empty strings are treated as null. Part numbers are the stable identity of a row on re-import (exact match); without one, the (case-insensitive) name is.

category.description: Free-text grouping for the legend (e.g. "Blade grip", "Tail boom"). Not the user-part part type.

diagram_x.description: Hotspot x, percentage (0-100) of the diagram width. Must be given together with diagram_y.

diagram_y.description: Hotspot y, percentage (0-100) of the diagram height. Must be given together with diagram_x.

parts.description: Parts of this model. Duplicates (same part_number, or same name when part_number is absent) are rejected. Parts removed from a later edit are NOT deleted on re-import; they are left in place and logged as orphans for manual review.
